title: EF English Proficiency Index 2026 Top 10
desc: The top ten of 117 countries and regions in the 2026 EF English Proficiency Index. The edition draws on online tests taken by self-selected adults in 2025 and earlier published index scores. Scores describe this test-taking sample and its rolling index.

source.name: EF Education First, 2026 English Proficiency Index
source.note: On 2026-11-28 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) matched ranks 1–10, names and integer index scores against the official web ranking and 2026 report, and checked Slovakia at rank 11. The edition uses 2025 EF SET tests from more than 2.3 million self-selected adults in 117 countries and regions. National scores combine the latest test average with the two previous published scores. See Appendix A for sampling and calculation details.
